notes: Avner, the Lampbearer (the moon; shaping moonlight). Every number is a first guess to tune. Sheets are made by scripts/avner-prep.mjs from the Avner_*.png drawings beside this file; a sheet with "placeholder" in its name stands in for art not drawn yet. The old chain kit (Brand, Vigil, Lumen Hook) is kept in data/characters/_archive/avner_chain/.
